# Rentgen ofert — Poland regional property data

> Regional dashboards aggregating house and flat sale listings in Poland.
> Listings are de-duplicated, carry price history, and may be matched to
> notarial RCN sale prices. Page content is in Polish.

## Start here

- https://110kc3.github.io/rentgen-ofert/ — national region picker
- https://110kc3.github.io/rentgen-ofert/data/regions.json — deployed region catalog with live counts, freshness, health and byte size
- https://110kc3.github.io/rentgen-ofert/sitemap.xml — published regional pages

The deployment generator replaces this fallback with a complete entry for
every region that actually has `site/data/<region>/meta.json`.

## Notes

- Source and pipeline: https://github.com/110kc3/rentgen-ofert
- Data has informational character; source portals and public registers are authoritative.
